requested_outcome: The available-stays loading state feels alive, special and clearly active instead of looking like a static placeholder, without delaying content or causing layout shift.
natural_destination: The VII homepage available-stays and holiday-stays sections during their initial API request and every tab change.
authorization_boundary: Change only the shared live-deals loading presentation, test it locally and prepare the release candidate. Preserve data fetching, tabs, result cards, links, copy and error behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: A source animation is not complete until the actual loading state is observed at its natural destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Capture the loading state and verify its transition into results without a jump or dead layer.

lesson_bundle.reason: The approved homepage content and cards must remain unchanged.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Only loading-state CSS and its contract test may change.

lesson_bundle.reason: The loading block must remain useful and contained on 390-pixel mobile and low-height screens.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify no horizontal overflow, clipped animation or blank first viewport on mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: The Hebrew loading label remains a visible brand surface.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve the existing approved font stack and readable loading label.

lesson_bundle.reason: Tabs and slider controls surrounding the loading state must keep their existing enabled and disabled semantics.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Motion polish must not change any control state or interaction.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The logo moves but the large background still feels static.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add independent ambient light, drifting point field, shimmer and staggered card motion.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At least three visually distinct motion layers are visible while the request is pending.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The animation is flashy, distracting or makes the site feel slower.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use low-amplitude transform and opacity animations with no timers, video or additional network requests.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Only compositor-friendly decorative layers move and the API begins immediately as before.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The new background causes overflow or a layout jump when results arrive.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the existing reserved height and clip decoration inside the loader.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height checks show no horizontal overflow and stable section height.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Users who request reduced motion still receive continuous animation.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Disable every added keyframe under prefers-reduced-motion.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The reduced-motion rule enumerates the ambient, card, shimmer, logo and line animations.

sources.label: User-provided screenshot of the current loading state

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the new ambient background and shimmer render in the first nearby-date loader.
checks: The background visibly moves independently of the logo.
The cards remain aligned to the final card geometry.
No data, copy, tabs or result behavior changed.

attack_questions: Can the loader still be mistaken for a frozen page?
Does any decorative layer escape the rounded loading surface?
Does reduced-motion still animate any added layer?
Did the visual change alter the loading-to-results transition or existing controls?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Local browser observation of the real homepage API loading state and its transition to results.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Visual and source checks for both loader modes, desktop, mobile, low-height and reduced motion.

effectiveness.baseline: The current logo travels across a short route and skeleton opacity pulses, but the large background and card surfaces read as static.
effectiveness.target: A clearly active but calm loader with no additional network request, no overflow and complete reduced-motion fallback.
